LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuShield.label: Guarding Ward
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuShield.description: The first hit is blocked and activates the layered shield. A lethal hit can trigger Stage III immediately. The shield starts with 24 layers and can reach 108 through cultivation. Hits below 36 damage are blocked without spending a layer. At 36 damage or above, each 36 damage spends one layer, rounded up. First-hit protection returns after 60 seconds without spending a layer. During Stage III, Neiyu is invulnerable and stores damage for 3 in-game hours. She then gains buffs for 12 in-game hours based on the damage stored, up to 5 stacks. She is weakened for 150 seconds afterward: the shield is capped at 24 layers and Stage III cannot trigger. If a hit needs more layers than remain, it exhausts the shield and is not blocked.
